text:
lara: Quick accessibility sweep on the new dashboard beta — found a few focus/VoiceOver oddities. TL;DR: primary nav links lose visible focus on mac Safari, status badges fail color-contrast at small sizes, and the alerts tray is double-announcing on screen readers. vik: ugh, thanks for catching. Which pages exactly? can you drop steps to repro? lara: repro steps: 1) open dashboard (beta) on mac Safari 16; 2) tab through top nav — the link gets keyboard focus but only a faint outline that disappears after 200ms (looks like we set outline: none somewhere). Also on /projects the green status chip (Success) is 3.8:1 on small text. aisha: on the double announce: I ran VoiceOver on mac and it reads "Alert: Build failed" then repeats "Build failed" shortly after. Looks like we have an aria-live="polite" container wrapping an element that also has role="status". aria-atomic and duplicate roles cause repeats. vik: sounds like two issues: CSS focus suppression and live-region structure. For the focus ring we probably removed it to match design tokens. We should use :focus-visible with a high-contrast box-shadow instead of outline: none. Example: ```css .button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,120,212,0.24); /* uses token --focus-ring */ border-radius: 6px; } ``` kevin: also saw a keyboard trap in the model-config modal — when you open the modal and tab past the last focusable item the focus jumps behind the modal (to the background app). backdrop has tabindex=-1 but the focus trap logic sometimes misses dynamic nodes. Logging a short SRE note in the release-war-room. aisha: for the live region: prefer a single dedicated, visually-hidden container with aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true" that only receives string updates. avoid role="status" on the same node and avoid duplicating announce text in nested nodes. Example pattern: ```html
``` update JS to set textContent to the new message; don't append. ```js const live = document.getElementById('a11y-live'); live.textContent = message; // replace not append ``` lara: good call. I also noted the keyboard order on the table bulk-actions dropdown — first tabbable item is visually below because of CSS transform used for animation. When we animate with transform + position: absolute we sometimes remove it from the tab flow. Use translateY with transform but ensure focusable children keep DOM order or temporarily disable transform for keyboard users. vik: will do a PR that: (1) restores good focus-visible styles, (2) fixes contrast token for status chips, and (3) swaps live-region usage to the single SR container. I'll also add a small e2e a11y check that tabs through the top nav. kevin: i'll add a short oncall note re: modal focus trap so releases don't regress it. a11y-bot: Automated scan results attached: [axe-core v4] violations: color-contrast (WCAG AA) x2, focusable-controls x1, aria-allowed-attr x1. Suggested fixes: update contrast tokens, remove outline:none without replacement, consolidate live regions. lara: action items: 1) vik — PR for focus & contrast & live-region (small, target patch release); 2) aisha — quick voiceover sanity check on mac and windows narrator; 3) kevin — monitor modal focus trap in release notes. I'll update the Figma tokens doc to reflect new focus ring and chip color token. vik: aiming to open PR by EOD tomorrow. putting notes in the PR description with repro steps. aisha: i'll run a quick VoiceOver pass once PR is up. lara: thanks team! small fixes, big UX win. :thumbsup:
